jobPostingInfo.title: Mid/Senior Software Engineer
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
Working at Infobip means being part of something truly global. With 75+ offices across six continents, we’re not just building technology — we’re shaping how more than 80% of the world connects and communicates.

 

As employees, we take pride in contributing to the world’s largest and only full-stack cloud communication platform. But it’s not just what we do, it’s how we do it: with curiosity, passion, and a whole lot of collaboration.

 

We operate with an AI-first mindset, embedding intelligent tools into our daily workflows to work smarter and more efficiently. Every role here benefits from and contributes to this approach.

 

If you're looking for meaningful work and challenges that grow you in a culture where people show up with purpose, this is your opportunity.

Let’s build what’s next, together.





Why we are hiring? 


In our Sarajevo engineering hub, we are developing Infobip’s global Voice product. Running on our proprietary infrastructure distributed across 40+ Data Centers worldwide, our platform serves as the communication layer for large global brands like Uber and LG, enabling them to deliver real-time communication at a massive scale. 


As voice technology evolves with the introduction of AI agents and smart automation, our product roadmap is growing significantly. To support these new capabilities and handle increasing global traffic, we are expanding our engineering footprint. We aren't just filling a single vacancy; we are forming a new team of Software Engineers to build the highly available, scalable architecture and microservices that make these modern innovations possible. 


You can explore our Voice API Documentation to see exactly what you’ll be working on. If you are looking to work on complex distributed systems and build solutions that are used worldwide, this is a great opportunity to join us.

 

What is this role all about?  

 

As a Mid or Senior Software Engineer at Infobip, you will be part of our Engineering Powerhouse, working on an in-house developed product that operates at a global scale. You will contribute to a large, scalable microservices architecture that delivers over 500 million messages daily and supports our clients’ business growth. 

This role is focused on our Voice platform, enabling instant, real-time audio communication for customers around the world. 

 

What you’ll do: 

 

  • Develop, maintain, monitor, and troubleshoot team-owned services on Infobip’s platform 
  • Take full ownership of the code you produce, from development to production 
  • Write well-designed, testable, and scalable code following clean code principles 
  • Have a general overview and understanding of the interactions and dependencies in the entire system 
  • Work primarily on backend development while growing toward full-stack development 
  • Work on and expand your knowledge in the realm of backend and frontend development, databases, system design, alerting and monitoring tools 
  • Collaborate closely with Product Management on feature development and delivery 
  • Apply an AI-first mindset, including exploring and integrating AI or LLM-based capabilities into product features where relevant. 

  

What makes you a strong fit: 

 

  • Strong knowledge and understanding of object-oriented programming principles 
  • Solid understanding of data structures and algorithms 
  • Willingness to learn and grow with us 
  • Experience working with concurrent and multi-tier applications 
  • Appreciation for code reviews and experience with code testing practices 
  • Good understanding of RESTful services 
  • You are comfortable using modern development approaches, including AI-assisted coding tools and agents. 

  

Nice-to-have qualifications 

 

  • Experience with Java, Spring, and Spring Boot development 
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, Git, Maven, Canary, or similar 
  • Understanding of databases and data management tools such as MSSQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, Kafka, or similar 
  • Ability to design and implement caching strategies that improve application performance and scalability 
  • Experience with technologies such as Java, Kotlin, Docker, or others 


Why you'll love it here • Financial rewards & recognition - A fair compensation aligned with your experience, industry, and market standards, performance-driven bonuses, regular reviews to support your growth and recognize your contributions, and a culture that values your impact. • Flexible work arrangements - Our hybrid, office-first setup brings people together in the office, with work-from-home flexibility and flexible working hours. • ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Plan) - As an Infobip employee, you’ll have the opportunity to share in our company’s success through stock options. • Work-life balance and Well-being - We offer time off when you need it, special leave days for life’s big moments, and a flexible hybrid work model tailored to local regulations. • Career mobility - Your career is a journey. With internal mobility, upskilling, and mentorship, we help you shape your path. • Professional development - Learning never stops. Onboarding, mentorship, and training programs help you grow - no matter where you start. • International mobility - Ready to take your career global? Explore short and long-term opportunities in our Hubs worldwide. While some benefits may vary by location, our goal remains the same: to support your growth, well-being, and success - wherever you are.



Diversity drives connection

Infobip is built on diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and talents. We’re proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace.

No matter your race, gender, age, background, or identity — if you have the passion and skills to thrive, there’s a place for you here.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, disability, veteran status or any other part of one's identity.
